title: Maintenance
intro: Change request CR-1: a completed task is never overdue. Change the helper and keep the rest.
taskPanel:
Change request CR-1: completed tasks are not overdue.

The team ticks a task off when it is done, but a done task still shows the overdue badge.

1. In web/src/lib/overdue.ts, make isOverdue return false for a completed task (done is true). Keep the date rule for open tasks as it is.
2. In web/src/lib/overdue.test.ts, add one regression test: a completed task due yesterday is not overdue. Keep the two tests already there.
3. Run the regression tests.
4. Fill the change request: the file you changed (Request tab), your test and the acceptance lines it covers (Checks tab), and the release: a version and one change line (Release tab).
objectives: Make isOverdue return false for a completed task (CR-1)
Add one regression test for a completed task
Keep the date rule for open tasks

ticket.title: Completed tasks are not overdue
ticket.summary: A task that is done never shows the overdue badge, whatever its due date. Open tasks keep the version 1 rule.

acceptance.line: A completed task is never overdue, whatever its due date.
An open task is overdue only when its due date is before today, as before.
